rows.title_full: AN ACT SEEKING TO IMPROVE CHILD PROTECTION AGAINST ABUSE, EXPLOITATION AND DISCRIMINATION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7610, AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7658, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"SPECIAL PROTECTION AND DISCRIMINATION ACT\", APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The bill bans and penalizes the employment of children in all forms of hazardous occupations and aims for \"greater participation of local social workers and law enforcers.\" Imposes penalties for child pornography through the internet. Mandates the creation of a central data bank to monitor abuses made by foreigners against children and prevent their reentry.

rows.abstract: \"Small Business Location and Incubator Act of 2004.\" Defines a business incubator as \"an organization set up to nurture young enterprises by providing them with a common office and service facilities such as technology transfer, training, marketing, etc. Aims to promote the survival of new enterprises during their early years by giving them technical and managerial support.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05811

rows.title_full: AN ACT CURTAILING THE ILLEGAL ACTIVITIES OF RACKETEERS AND POWERFUL SYNDICATES IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organization (RICO) Act
rows.abstract: \"Racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organization (RICO) Act.\" The bill imposes stiff penalties against criminal syndicates such as drug traffickers, money launderers, smugglers, kidnappers, etc., depriving them of their operational fund and denying them the money obtained from their illegal acts by forfeiting it in favor of the government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2004-08-09

rows.title_short: Anti-Red Tape Act of 2004
rows.abstract: \"Anti-Red Tape Act of 2004.\" The bill prescribes the following waiting period for the issuance of business permits: a) barangay-one day to 30 days; b) city or municipality-one day to 45 days; c) province-15 days to 60 days ; and d) national agencies-15 days to 120 days.
rows.status: Substituted by HB03776
